And in time I had to consolidate some, and save the content in a subfolder for documentation. My goal of 2025 is to have only saiht.de available for personal information and kreier.org for work related information and projects. Current Domains - 3 are still alive saiht.de 1999-2026 This continues to be my personal Website. I started in 1999 with a few pages in German, and used frames to separate the navigation from the content. This approach is long deprecated, have a look at the current version saiht.de And some information has been stored in the dedicated page saiht.de here in obsidian. kreier.org 2018-2026 With my new job at AISVN I started to create my own website to provide student material for my IB Physics course. In the end this turned out to be very time consuming! Some details about the creation are written at kreier.org . And the current iteration at https://kreier.org . people.physik.hu-berlin.de-kreier 2000-2026 This webspace is provided by my university. And since it is hosted in the Institutrechenzentrum with some ultrafast fibre internet connection (we do research, after all) this should serve all my purposes well. A little more background at people.physik.hu-berlin.de-kreier . Not much has changed since 2008 here: people.physik.hu-berlin.de/~kreier/ . Here is the list of websites I owned over the years.
